generations.name: 24.2 kWh (2015-2016)
generations.notes: US launch MY2015 (Mk7 Golf): 24.2 kWh pack, EPA 83 mi. CCS1 DC fast charging (about 40 kW class) on most or all trims; sources conflict on whether it was standard on every 2015 trim, and on the onboard charger (7.2 kW per Edmunds vs 6.6 kW per Autobytel/Cars.com). Not sold in Canada until MY2017 (NRCan rows start 2017). EPA labels it base model "Golf/GTI"; this map uses the "e-Golf" label prefix instead so no gasoline Golf could ever match. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://avt.inl.gov/sites/default/files/pdf/fsev/fact2140egolf2015.pdf ; https://www.recurrentauto.com/used-ev-guides/volkswagen-e-golf ; https://www.edmunds.com/volkswagen/e-golf/2016/review/

generations.name: 35.8 kWh (2017 on)
generations.notes: MY2017 update: 35.8 kWh pack (EPA 125 mi), 7.2 kW onboard charger standard, CCS1 DC standard on SEL Premium and a $995 option on SE. EPA rows run to 2019, NRCan rows to 2020 (US sales ended with MY2019; Canada had a 2020). Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://www.cars.com/articles/2017-volkswagen-e-golf-ups-range-power-and-price-1420697182372 ; https://autoevolution.com/news/volkswagen-e-golf-updated-for-2017-my-range-doubles-to-124-miles-113012.html
